title: From Values to Frameworks: A Qualitative Study of Ethical Reasoning in Agentic AI Practitioners

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative interviews assessing AI practitioners' ethical reasoning and decision-making when presented with a hypothetical dilemma where an AI scheduling agent's task assignments correlate with worker gender (favoring males).

Qualitative interviews assessing AI practitioners' ethical reasoning and decision-making when presented with a hypothetical dilemma where an AI scheduling agent's task assignments correlate with whether workers have children (favoring those without).

Qualitative interviews assessing AI practitioners' ethical reasoning and decision-making when presented with a hypothetical dilemma where an AI scheduling agent's task assignments correlate with worker age (favoring younger workers).
